item.title: Terra for personal chats, Sol for groups
item.summary: Personal chats now start with GPT-6.1 Terra. Every group keeps GPT-6.1 Sol. Terra is available in Settings.
item.details: Existing model preferences reset to these defaults. Sol in personal chats requires a paid subscription; Sol in groups is available to everyone. Astra remains available on paid Edge and Max plans. Your reasoning setting stays the same.
